title: Alert
description: One user alert: the payload of an alert:<id> document. Created by notify_user, workflow notify nodes and workflow pauses; the backend shows it in the alert center and asks Progenitor to relay it to the user.

source.description: What raised it, e.g. notify_user, workflow:<id>.

context.description: Machine-readable details for answering it, e.g. a paused workflow run or routine thread and who may answer (approver).
